description: Use when your principal wants signed proof for a whole deliverable: checks every third-party input (resource_id, license or asset) for its use, reusing licenses you hold, and returns a signed, ledger-committed manifest plus a plain-text summary; verify_rights_manifest checks it. Call with {"title": "Spring campaign", "intended_use": {"commercial_use": true}, "items": [{"ref": "font", "license": "OFL-1.1"}]}.

api_key.description: Deprecated: use Authorization: Bearer <key> (arguments can reach transcripts).

idempotency_key.description: Optional: a retry with the same key returns the first proof.

intended_use.description: Intended use: every true flag is a right the check must find documented; omitted flags are false; unknown fields are refused. For instance {"commercial_use":true,"deployment":true,"attribution_planned":true,"duration_days":365}

duration_days.description: Whole days of use (1 to 36500), or null for no fixed term

geography.description: worldwide (default) or a region code such as US, EU, UK

intended_use.description: Optional per-item override, same shape as intended_use

name: issue_rights_manifest
title: Issue a rights manifest for a deliverable
